name: Conduct Financial Services
description: Guard controls aligned to US banking model risk management for agentic AI. Interim controls covering SR 11-7 principles while agent-specific guidance is pending.

rules.description: Block tier-3 agent action without a recorded human oversight event within the last 24 hours
rules.message: Tier-3 agent action requires a recorded human oversight event. Route to review before commit.
rules.recommendation: Require an explicit human review event, recorded in the audit chain, before any tier-3 agent action commits.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks the tier-3 agent action when human oversight evidence is missing from the run context.
requires: Human review events are recorded in the hash-chained audit
known_limitations: Depends on agent_identity risk_tier being set correctly at agent registration

rules.description: Warn on model swap mid-workflow without a change control event
rules.message: Model swap during a workflow requires a change control event. Silent model changes break validation.
rules.recommendation: Record every model swap as a change control event with reason and approver.

enforcement.guarantee: Warns on model swap without accompanying change control event.
requires: Model identity is visible in tool_input or proxy context
known_limitations: Model swaps inside third-party gateways may not surface as observable events

rules.description: Block agent lifecycle promotion to production without documented owner attestation
rules.message: Agent promotion to production requires documented owner attestation. Route to change control.
rules.recommendation: Require owner attestation as an approval event before promoting any agent to production.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks lifecycle promotion actions when attestation event is missing from context.
requires: Attestation events recorded in the audit chain
known_limitations: Depends on lifecycle promotion being surfaced as a tool call

rules.description: Block agent write to core banking or ledger systems without segregation-of-duties check
rules.message: Agent action on core banking system requires segregation-of-duties evidence. Two-person integrity check required.
rules.recommendation: Route core banking writes through a two-person integrity check.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks agent-initiated writes to matching core banking tools without SoD event in context.
requires: Core banking tools use identifiable names or MCP servers
known_limitations: Custom tool names not in the match pattern must be added per deployment

rules.description: Block agent decision on credit or lending determinations without human-in-the-loop attestation
rules.message: Regulated financial decisions require human-in-the-loop attestation. Agent may recommend but cannot commit.
rules.recommendation: Agents may generate recommendations but a human must be the accountable decision-maker.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks agent decisions on regulated determinations without human attestation event.
requires: Regulated tool categories tagged in tool descriptions or MCP metadata
known_limitations: New tool categories may need to be added to the match pattern

rules.description: Block agent action on customer PII or account data without documented control mapping
rules.message: Agent action on regulated data class requires documented control mapping.
rules.recommendation: Every agent touching regulated data classes must have a documented control mapping.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks agent actions when data class is regulated and control mapping evidence is missing.
requires: Tool inputs or context carry data classification tags
known_limitations: Data classification depends on upstream tagging discipline

rules.description: Block agent read across customer tenants or portfolio boundaries without explicit permit
rules.message: Cross-tenant or cross-portfolio customer data access blocked. Requires explicit permit and audit entry.
rules.recommendation: Constrain agents to a single tenant or portfolio scope.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks agent reads matching cross-tenant or wildcard scope patterns.
requires: Tool inputs include tenant or customer scope
known_limitations: Custom scope field names may need to be added to the pattern

rules.description: Warn on cost accrual approaching per-agent monthly cap set by model risk committee
rules.message: Agent monthly spend has reached 80 percent of committee cap. Notify model risk committee owner.
rules.recommendation: Set per-agent monthly caps at the model risk committee level.

enforcement.guarantee: Warns when the spend cache indicates approaching a defined cap.
requires: Per-agent spend caps configured in Guard settings
known_limitations: Cost measurement latency depends on provider billing feed frequency
